messages.subject: Re: TVECM introducing additional regressors (beta0)
parts:
Dear Kifle

Ccing to the tsDyn mailing list.

Thanks for your message. There is indeed a beta0 argument, but I must say this is an option I added long time ago, and I am not very satisfied with. I would unfortunately rather sugest not to use it, since the short test I did showed a few issues that cast doubts into the accuracy of this option.

Sorry for this!

Best

Matthieu


2013/6/2 <kif...@gmail.com>
Dear Matthieu
I am using the program you developed in R, i.e. TVECM. We really thank for that.
I want to introduce additional regressors to include in the cointegrating relation. I am new to R and struggling as there is no example. can you please lend your hand to make my life easier? Here is the command:
library(foreign)
maindata<-read.csv("C:/Users/NUNU/Desktop/maindata/1market011320.csv")
m<- subset(maindata, marketid==0)
k<-subset(m, trend<150)
maindatats<-ts(k, frequency=12, start=c(1997, 7))
gallcons<-TVECM(maindatats[,4:5],lag=1,nthresh=1, trim=0.05, ngridBeta=50, ngridTh=50, plot=TRUE, common=c("All"), include = c( "const"),dummyToBothRegimes=TRUE,beta0=0,methodMapply=FALSE, trace=TRUE )
summary(gallcons)
Many thanks

Kifle
